title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 20m. Expresses concern about the lack of provisions introducing delegated or implementing acts for the adoption of annual work programmes, which allows the Commission to establish work programmes without ex ante scrutiny by Parliament; insists that annual work programmes involving policy choices must be adopted through delegated or implementing acts, thereby preserving Parliament’s and the Council’s scrutiny rights; emphasises that the systematic use of comitology procedures should not be used to avoid parliamentary scrutiny;
